# chronosphere_blazemeter_api_monitoring_external_connection (Resource)

BlazeMeter API Monitoring access token that a `chronosphere_cloud_integration` with `provider_type = "blazemeter_api_monitoring"` references through `external_connection_slug` to collect BlazeMeter API Monitoring test results.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "blazemeter_api_monitoring_access_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "chronosphere_blazemeter_api_monitoring_external_connection" "blazemeter_api_monitoring" {
  name         = "BlazeMeter API Monitoring"
  access_token = var.blazemeter_api_monitoring_access_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) BlazeMeter API Monitoring (formerly Runscope) access token, sent as a bearer token to read test results. The API never returns the token, so a token changed outside Terraform is not detected, and an imported connection plans one update to set it.
- `name` (String) Display name of the external connection.

### Optional

- `slug` (String) Stable identifier for the connection. Generated from `name` if omitted. Immutable after creation, so changing it replaces the connection. If a `chronosphere_cloud_integration` uses the connection, the replacement needs `create_before_destroy` and a new `name` in the same apply, because a connection in use cannot be deleted and names are unique.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
